name: TaskPilot
tagline: AI project planning for small agencies.
description: TaskPilot turns client briefs into clear plans, weekly priorities, and shareable progress updates for small agencies.
bestFor: Small agencies that want opinionated planning without enterprise overhead.
notBestFor: Large organizations that require on-premise deployment and complex portfolio controls.

name: ReplyRadar
tagline: Find the customer signal hiding in support conversations.
description: ReplyRadar clusters support conversations into recurring themes so product teams know what to fix next.
bestFor: Lean product teams with support data but no dedicated research operation.
notBestFor: Teams looking for a full help desk or ticketing system.

name: InvoiceFox
description: InvoiceFox gives independent consultants a calm way to quote, invoice, and keep payment status in one place.
bestFor: Consultants and small studios sending fewer than 100 invoices per month.
notBestFor: Businesses that need payroll, inventory, or multi-entity accounting.

name: PatchKit
tagline: A quiet release checklist for small engineering teams.
description: PatchKit is a lightweight release checklist for teams that want fewer forgotten steps and clearer ownership.
bestFor: Small engineering teams preparing their first public release.
notBestFor: Teams needing a full CI/CD platform or incident-management suite.
